bugs.error_message: When editing a site, only checkpoint and radius edits are saved. Name, address, and work hours changes are lost.
bugs.root_cause: @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true) on deleteBySiteId cleared the JPA first-level cache after the DELETE ran. Spring's FlushModeType.AUTO does not auto-flush the dirty Site entity before a DELETE on the unrelated SiteCheckpoint table, so the pending site UPDATE was in the EntityManager cache but never flushed to DB. clearAutomatically then evicted it, discarding name/address/workStartTime/workEndTime changes.
bugs.fix: Added flushAutomatically = true to the @Modifying annotation: @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true). This forces a flush of all dirty entities (including the modified Site) before the DELETE executes, ensuring the site UPDATE reaches the DB before the cache is cleared.

bugs.error_message: Workers remain with open shifts the next day despite auto-checkout cron running
bugs.root_cause: Three compounding bugs: (1) findUnclosedCheckIns had `AND a.site.workEndTime IS NOT NULL` — workers at sites without a configured end time were silently excluded. (2) Scheduler searched only yesterday's window — offline sync records arriving after 00:01 were permanently missed by all future runs. (3) NOT EXISTS used `co.recordedAt >= :from` (global window) instead of `co.recordedAt > a.recordedAt` (per check-in scope) — a checkout from a previous session could incorrectly cancel out detection of a newer open session.
bugs.fix: AttendanceRepository: removed workEndTime IS NOT NULL filter; changed NOT EXISTS to `co.recordedAt > a.recordedAt`. AutoCheckoutScheduler: rolling 7-day lookback window instead of yesterday only; fallback endTime = 23:59 for sites without workEndTime; checkOutTime computed relative to checkIn date (not hardcoded yesterday). Added POST /api/attendance/auto-checkout admin endpoint for manual recovery.
